name: catalyst-q
description: Run quantum circuits through a hosted API and get exact answers, or a refusal with the numbers. Includes an advisor that says when not to use it. Not a quantum computer.

interface.shortDescription: Exact answers for quantum circuits, or a refusal with the numbers.
interface.longDescription: Ask an advisor whether Catalyst-Q helps with your task, then run circuits, draw shots, price specific outcomes, score counts from a device and compute expectation values. It is classical and noiseless, and it is not a quantum computer.
capabilities: Advisor that says when not to use it
defaultPrompt: Would Catalyst-Q help with the circuits in this repo?
Score these device counts against the circuit that produced them.
What noiseless value should my QAOA run be chasing?
